events.subtitle: LIVE TOUR 2026 ‘Starting Over’ in TOKYO Release Event — Talk & Live
events.category: Japanese technical rock / twin-guitar / release-event live
events.factual_description: KOIAI's official site presents the LIVE TOUR 2026 ‘Starting Over’ in TOKYO Release Event — Talk & Live at Yokohama Bay Hall on Sunday, October 25, 2026, with doors at 2:00 PM and the event beginning at 3:00 PM. The ticket is ¥5,000 including tax for an all-standing event, with a separate drink charge. The program includes a KOIAI live performance plus a talk segment with guest MC Ken Ayugai. The event accompanies the October 28 release of the Blu-ray documenting KOIAI's July 31 Tokyo performance at Meijiza during the Starting Over tour / HEAVY KAWAII FES 2026; attendees can purchase the Blu-ray at the venue before general release, and purchasers are eligible for the announced signing session. KOIAI's official profile identifies the current five-member lineup as Mirei Sakurada on voice, Li-sa-X and Hazuki on guitars, Yunika Impact on bass and Kanade Sato on drums; the current lineup was completed when Yunika joined in March 2026.

enrichment.note: Date, venue, doors/start time, event format, ticket price, authorized ticket destination, Blu-ray release context, current official five-member lineup and exact Apple Music EP destination are verified. No unannounced setlist or additional performers are inferred.

Official August 30 announcement verifies that the event accompanies the October 28 live Blu-ray release documenting the July 31 Meijiza performance, confirms the live-and-talk format and early venue purchase/signing context.
Official profile identifies Mirei Sakurada, Li-sa-X, Hazuki, Yunika Impact and Kanade Sato as the current lineup and states that the five-member formation was completed in March 2026.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to keep this on RADAR is the moment in KOIAI's own transition, not a generic release promotion. The five-member formation only became complete this year, and Starting Over is the first EP from that lineup; now the same phase is being turned into an official live document. Hearing the band play while the event looks back at the Meijiza performance puts Li-sa-X and Hazuki's twin-guitar architecture, Kanade Sato's drumming and the new rhythm-and-vocal configuration in a useful before-and-after frame.
en.trip_verdict: If October already puts you in Tokyo or Yokohama, attend if convenient, especially if technical Japanese rock and twin-guitar writing are part of the trip. I would fit it around rarer master, farewell or one-off Kanto dates rather than reorganize the itinerary specifically for this release event.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para meter esta fecha al RADAR es el momento dentro de la propia transición de KOIAI, no una promoción genérica de lanzamiento. La formación de cinco integrantes apenas quedó completa este año y Starting Over es el primer EP de esa alineación; ahora esa misma etapa se convierte en un documento oficial en vivo. Escuchar a la banda mientras la noche vuelve sobre la actuación de Meijiza pone las dos guitarras de Li-sa-X y Hazuki, la batería de Kanade Sato y la nueva configuración rítmica y vocal dentro de un contexto claro de antes y después.
es.trip_verdict: Si octubre ya te pone en Tokio o Yokohama, entraría si queda cómodo, especialmente si el rock técnico japonés y la escritura de dos guitarras forman parte del viaje. La acomodaría alrededor de apariciones más raras de maestros, despedidas o fechas únicas en Kanto, en vez de reorganizar el itinerario específicamente por este evento de lanzamiento.
